title: Cartesianity of glued model charts
statement: Let $p:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes and let $V\to X$ and $W_i\to Y$, $W_0\to Y$ be schemes over their indicated bases [def-weil-scheme-over-base]. Let $U_i\subseteq V$ be open subschemes and $q_i:U_i\to W_i$, $q_0:V\to W_0$, $j_i:W_i\to W_0$ be morphisms. Suppose the local squares $(q_i,U_i\to X,W_i\to Y,p)$ are cartesian [def-pc-fibre-product], each $j_i$ is an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], the $j_i$ jointly cover $W_0$, each $j_i$ is over $Y$, and $q_i j_i=(U_i\to V)q_0$. Suppose also that $q_0^{-1}(j_i(W_i))=U_i$ for every $i$, as supplied by the descended overlap gluing construction. Then each chart square $(q_i,U_i\to V,j_i,q_0)$ is cartesian. The last inverse-image assumption is indispensable for arbitrary commuting charts; the local cartesian, covering, and over-base hypotheses are retained but unnecessary for this open-immersion criterion.

proof.text: For each index install the given open-immersion instance of j_i. The source inclusion U_i -> V is an open immersion with opensRange U_i. The supplied inverse-image equality therefore satisfies Mathlib IsOpenImmersion.isPullback; its commuting-square equation is the symmetric hcomm i. This proves the chart square cartesian directly. Empty index types are vacuous and empty opens require no separate argument.

proof_origin.place: Chart-square verification, IsOpenImmersion.isPullback; Lean proof by E3

lean.statement:
theorem glued_model_chart_pullbacks
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {p : X ⟶ Y} {V : Over X}
    {I : Type u} (U : I → V.left.Opens) (W : I → Over Y)
    (q : ∀ i, (U i).toScheme ⟶ (W i).left)
    (W₀ : Over Y) (q₀ : V.left ⟶ W₀.left)
    (j : ∀ i, (W i).left ⟶ W₀.left)
    (hcart : ∀ i, IsPullback (q i) ((U i).ι ≫ V.hom) (W i).hom p)
    (hopen : ∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (j i))
    (hcover : ∀ w : W₀.left, ∃ i, ∃ z : (W i).left, j i z = w)
    (hover : ∀ i, j i ≫ W₀.hom = (W i).hom)
    (hcomm : ∀ i, q i ≫ j i = (U i).ι ≫ q₀)
    (hpreimage : ∀ i, q₀ ⁻¹ᵁ (j i).opensRange = U i) :
    ∀ i, IsPullback (q i) (U i).ι (j i) q₀

statement_change.what: The existing STATEMENT-DISPUTED counterexample shows that arbitrary commuting charts need not be cartesian. Add the necessary inverse-image equality. It is now proved from the actual descended overlaps in the sole Lean caller, whose statement is unchanged. The item is an intermediate criterion, not a target or a realized unit statement. Replace its circular statement dependency on the existential caller with the definitions actually used.

old_proof.text: STATEMENT-DISPUTED: arbitrary target open charts and commuting maps need not be glued from the descended overlaps. The singleton identity chart on X and the first component U of V=X coproduct X, with q₀ the fold map, meet the displayed hypotheses but the chart square is not cartesian. Actual gluing must establish the inverse-image equalities first; the corrected single-chart criterion then applies indexwise. The unchanged caller is left disputed rather than proving a false inverse-image lemma.
